title: Small generators for the saturated trivial cofibrations
statement: Fix a universe and let $\mathcal A$ be a category with small Hom sets and all small limits and colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Suppose $\mathcal A$ is locally presentable: for some infinite regular cardinal $\kappa$ it is generated under small $\kappa$-filtered colimits by a small set of objects $P$ whose functors $\operatorname{Hom}(P,-)$ preserve those colimits. A cardinal $\kappa$ is regular if a union of fewer than $\kappa$ sets of size less than $\kappa$ has size less than $\kappa$; a category is $\kappa$-filtered if every diagram with fewer than $\kappa$ morphisms admits a cocone. Let $C,W$ be classes of arrows of $\mathcal A$, and let $\mathcal A^{[1]}$ be its category of arrows and commuting squares. Use arrow retracts as defined in [lem-coef-lifting-class-closure]. Call an arrow class weakly saturated if it contains all isomorphisms and is closed under pushouts, small transfinite compositions and arrow retracts; a transfinite composition is the map from the first object to the colimit of an ordinal-indexed sequence continuous at limit ordinals. Assume $C$ is weakly saturated and generated as such by a small subset $C_0$, that $C\cap W$ is weakly saturated, and that $W$ has two-out-of-three: for composable $f,g$, membership of any two of $f,g,gf$ in $W$ implies membership of the third. Assume also that the full subcategory on $W$ is accessible: for some infinite regular $\lambda$ it is closed under small $\lambda$-filtered colimits in the arrow category and is generated under those colimits by a small set of its objects. Then there is a small subset $S\subseteq C\cap W$ which generates $C\cap W$ as a weakly saturated class.
